name: flap-whoosh
prompt: A single soft wing flap whoosh: a quick airy swoosh of feathers cutting through wind, light and gentle, storybook tone.

name: takeoff-rise
prompt: A rising whoosh of wind lifting upward, a bright ascending airy sweep ending in a soft chime, cheerful takeoff.

name: gate-pass-chime
prompt: A bright two-note crystalline chime ding, a pleasant mallet bell tone with a short shimmer, rewarding and light.

name: centered-sparkle
prompt: A sparkling glockenspiel twinkle, a quick ascending glitter of tiny bell tones, magical and precise.

name: clear-fanfare
prompt: A short triumphant fanfare of bright brass and bells rising through four happy notes, a celebratory stage-clear flourish.

name: time-up-fanfare
prompt: A gentle upbeat completion jingle, warm bells resolving upward, a friendly time-is-up round-over motif.

name: crash-thud
prompt: A soft low thud of a small bird tumbling into the sea with a muffled splash and a descending disappointed wobble, not harsh.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: A short low muted buzz, a dull wooden not-allowed bonk, soft and brief interface denial sound.

name: ui-tick
prompt: A tiny clean wooden UI click tick, a short soft percussive tap, minimal menu selection sound.

name: countdown-beep
prompt: A single clear electronic countdown beep, mid-pitch, short and round, a friendly timer tick.

name: countdown-go
prompt: A higher bright go beep with a slight sparkle tail, an energetic start signal chime.

name: achievement-sparkle
prompt: A shimmering achievement-unlock arpeggio of tiny bells rising in three steps with a glittering tail, a magical reward.

name: undo-rewind
prompt: A short downward rewind swoop, a tape-rewind-like descending whirr, soft and quick.

name: ambience-wind
prompt: Soft continuous high-altitude wind moving gently past, airy and warm with faint distant wind chimes, a calm daytime sky ambience loop, smooth and even with no gusts.

name: ambience-night
prompt: Quiet still night-sky ambience: a very soft low wind hush with sparse faraway crickets and an occasional tiny glassy twinkle, calm and even, gentle starlit loop.

name: streak-rise
prompt: A quick rising three-note bell run climbing upward with a bright shimmering tail, a short escalating combo streak chime, precise and rewarding.

name: best-sting
prompt: A warm celebratory personal-best sting: a soft brass swell rising into a bright bell ping with a gentle sparkle tail, proud and brief.
